us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Delta automation problem delays flights during Thanksgiving travel rush
bullets: Delta reported an automation-system problem affecting operations Sunday.
The FAA issued a temporary ground stop for some Atlanta-bound flights.
The disruption hit as Thanksgiving travel volumes began rising.

articles.title: Democrats secure largest House majority since 1992 after North Carolina call
bullets: AP projected Democrat Chuck Hubbard won North Carolina’s 5th District.
The call expanded Democrats’ House majority after the 2026 midterms.
The result added to Republican losses in previously competitive territory.

articles.title: North Carolina Legislature splits control between Democrats and Republicans
bullets: AP projected Democrats won control of the North Carolina House.
Republicans retained control of the state Senate.
The split legislature sets up divided control in Raleigh.

articles.title: US Army plans emergency detonation of bomb-making chemicals in Iowa
bullets: The Army plans to invoke emergency provisions for the detonation.
Officials identified the material as bomb-making chemicals in Iowa.
The action was listed in AP’s Monday morning news summary.

articles.title: Platte River bridge near Schuyler reopens after closure
bullets: Local officials reopened the bridge over the Platte River near Schuyler.
The update was posted Sunday, ahead of Monday morning travel.
The reopening affects regional traffic in eastern Nebraska.

articles.title: Zelenskyy praises Ukrainian drone strike on Russian warship in Libya
bullets: Ukraine said naval drones struck a Russian warship in Libyan waters.
Zelenskyy praised the operation by Ukraine’s security services.
AP described it as a long-range strike far from Ukraine’s front line.

articles.title: UN climate talks collapse without major fossil-fuel deal
bullets: AP reported the climate talks ended without a comprehensive agreement.
Fossil-fuel language remained a central sticking point.
The United States did not participate in the negotiations.

articles.title: Climate negotiators react after talks end without deal
bullets: Leaders and delegates expressed disappointment after the talks closed.
Small and vulnerable states sought stronger emissions and finance commitments.
The final outcome left major climate-policy disputes unresolved.

articles.title: Canada’s Carney roasts Trump and politicians at press gallery dinner
bullets: Prime Minister Mark Carney appeared with a fake Donald Trump onstage.
The event was Canada’s annual press gallery dinner with journalists.
Opposition leader Pierre Poilievre also delivered political jokes.

articles.title: Kyiv’s allies push back after Trump-Putin diplomacy alarms Europe
bullets: European leaders discussed Ukraine security after Trump’s Asia meetings.
Zelenskyy joined talks with European leaders and US envoys.
Le Monde reported allies were resisting pressure on Kyiv.

articles.title: India announces $1.6 billion package for Nepal during Balen Shah visit
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a major development package for Nepal.
Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah visited India from November 22–23.
The two sides unveiled a joint vision to reset ties.

articles.title: Modi announces offshore IIT campus plan in Nepal
bullets: The announcement came during Nepal PM Balendra Shah’s India visit.
It was framed as part of expanded India-Nepal cooperation.
The proposal was highlighted in Monday current-affairs updates.

articles.title: Supreme Court weighs BS-VI mandate for Delhi amid pollution concerns
bullets: The Supreme Court considered matters linked to Delhi-NCR air pollution.
The issue included vehicle-emission standards in the capital region.
The hearing was listed among Monday’s major India developments.

articles.title: Supreme Court to hear West Bengal electoral-roll revision pleas
bullets: The court listed petitions on Special Intensive Revision in West Bengal.
Petitioners included Mamata Banerjee, Rahul Gandhi and INDIA bloc leaders.
The pleas allege irregularities in the revision process.

articles.title: ICC to introduce bat gauges in cricket rule enforcement
bullets: The ICC move was included in Monday’s national news brief.
Bat gauges are intended to standardize equipment checks.
The update appeared alongside major India policy and court stories.

articles.title: US futures rise as tech attempts rebound from AI-led rout
bullets: US equity futures climbed early Monday after a brutal sell-off.
Technology shares led the premarket recovery attempt.
AP said investors were watching AI-linked stocks closely.

articles.title: AI spending worries pressure market sentiment after sell-off
bullets: Axios reported investors are reassessing AI capital-spending expectations.
UBS said markets need evidence of AI monetization.
The story followed sharp declines in AI-linked equities.

articles.title: Anthropic and AI stocks remain focus after Nasdaq plunge
bullets: Kiplinger reported the Nasdaq dropped sharply Friday.
Anthropic and other AI-linked shares led market attention.
The sell-off came after volatile trading around AI valuations.

articles.title: Zscaler jumps premarket after CrowdStrike deal report
bullets: Swingfolio reported Zscaler shares rose sharply before Monday’s open.
The move followed a reported CrowdStrike all-stock acquisition agreement.
CrowdStrike shares fell in the same premarket update.

articles.title: Chip and memory stocks remain volatile after last week’s drop
bullets: Market updates showed semiconductor names rebounding in premarket trading.
Friday’s rout hit memory and AI-infrastructure stocks hard.
Nvidia remained a key driver of index swings.

articles.title: Home Depot CEO transition takes effect after market turbulence
bullets: Kiplinger reported Ted Decker would leave the CEO role November 23.
CFO Richard McPhail was set to replace him.
The update came during a sharp Dow sell-off last week.

articles.title: CrowdStrike agrees to buy Zscaler in all-stock cybersecurity deal
bullets: The reported deal valued Zscaler at about $43.9 billion.
CrowdStrike shareholders would own most of the combined company.
The companies targeted $1 billion in extra annual revenue.

articles.title: Investors look to PMIs and policy data in shortened Thanksgiving week
bullets: US markets face a holiday-shortened trading week.
S&P Global flash PMIs were scheduled for Monday.
GDP and PCE data were expected later in the week.

articles.title: OPPD proposes 3% residential electricity-rate increase
bullets: Omaha Public Power District proposed higher residential electricity rates.
The proposed increase was listed at 3%.
The update was reported by Telemundo Nebraska on Sunday.

articles.title: Markets monitor China margin-rule support after AI-stock wipeout
bullets: Reuters-linked market reports said China planned margin-rule easing.
The measure would reduce minimum margins for financed stock purchases.
The change was expected to begin November 30.

articles.title: AI trade enters new phase as investors question spending boom
bullets: Axios said the AI trade entered uncharted territory after market declines.
Investors are focused on capex growth and monetization.
The shift follows months of rapid AI-stock gains.

articles.title: Trump threatens tax on US companies building AI data centers abroad
bullets: AP reported Trump threatened a tax on overseas AI data-center builds.
The proposal highlights tensions over AI infrastructure location.
The policy targets companies expanding computing capacity outside the US.

articles.title: FBI investigates apparent hack of key criminal-justice database
bullets: AP reported the FBI was investigating an apparent database hack.
The system is tied to national criminal-justice operations.
The incident followed a broader wave of November technology outages.

articles.title: European commercial refrigerator hacks prompt security operation
bullets: BBC reported an operation to secure commercial fridges and freezers.
The action targeted cyber risks in connected refrigeration equipment.
The issue was listed among November 2026 UK technology developments.

articles.title: NHS begins recruiting for major AI breast-cancer screening trial
bullets: The NHS began recruiting participants on November 23.
The trial uses AI in breast-cancer screening.
It was described as the world’s largest trial of its kind.
